trimmedBy: none: the body is stored exactly as received (a plain-text 404 is not JSON, hence .txt)
notes: PERMISSION IS UNCLEAR, NOT DOCUMENTED-PUBLIC: the endpoint is documented without credentials, but https://api.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt answers HTTP 401, so this host states no robots verdict and the permission field must not read stronger than that. A board that does not exist answers HTTP 404 with the PLAIN TEXT body "Not Found" (content-type text/plain), not JSON - hence the .txt extension. The slug is deliberately fictitious. Documented (https://developers.ashbyhq.com/docs/public-job-posting-api): a public endpoint with no credentials in the example; the page states no rate limit or terms of use. robots.txt: https://api.ashbyhq.com/robots.txt answers HTTP 401, so NO robots verdict exists for the API host (recorded as such, not as permission). The payload carries NO employer name; employer evidence is the posting text naming the employer. includeCompensation=true was requested; every job carries a compensation object, empty tiers where the employer published none. isListed was true on every one of 1,612 postings across 10 non-empty boards, so no unlisted posting was ever captured. DECISION AND COST: publishedAt is documented as the last publish and is read as PUBLISHED; the content hash covers PUBLISHED, so an Ashby re-publish with identical content changes contentHash (reading it as UPDATED would keep the hash stable but leave Ashby vacancies without a publication date). E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
